templates.name: Friendly Coach
templates.tagline: Rounded pastel blobs, bouncy display type, and a friendly, human voice — for a course that feels like coaching, not a syllabus.
templates.best_for: Solo coaches, creators, and community-run courses that want to feel warm and human rather than institutional. Great for a first cohort or a hobby turning into a teaching business.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that need institutional gravitas — the rounded shapes and bright palette are intentionally informal.

templates.name: Professional Academy
templates.tagline: Navy-and-white, structured and credible — for a program that needs to read as a serious professional credential.
templates.best_for: Programs that need to read as established and low-risk to invest in: corporate training, certifications, bootcamps, professional upskilling sold to employers or serious career-changers.
templates.avoid_for: Contexts that want to feel indie, playful, or personal — the navy palette and grid structure read as institutional by design.
